intro.en: Appointments, tests, specialists and sick leave: the health system in words.

dar el alta.en: to discharge; to sign back to work

titulo.en: Going to the doctor in Spain

texto.en:
The public system works through **el centro de salud**, where your **médico de cabecera** sees you. You **pides cita**, by phone or online. For something serious you go to **urgencias**.

The doctor may send you to **el especialista** (el dentista, el oculista, el ginecólogo), order **un análisis de sangre**, or give you **una receta**.

If you cannot work, the doctor **te da la baja**, and you **estás de baja**. When you are well, **te dan el alta**.

In hospital: **ingresar**, **operar**, **dar el alta**.

Remedies: **tomar** un antibiótico; **echarse** unas gotas; **ponerse** una vacuna; **darse** una crema.

The verbs of falling ill and recovering: **ponerse enfermo**, **encontrarse** mal, **mejorar**, **curarse**.

frases.es: Buenos días. Quería pedir cita con mi médica.
frases.en: Good morning. I'd like to make an appointment with my doctor.

frases.es: ¿Para cuándo? Mañana a las diez está libre.
frases.en: For when? Tomorrow at ten is free.

frases.es: Perfecto. Llevo tres días mareado y no he ido a trabajar.
frases.en: Perfect. I've been dizzy for three days and I haven't been to work.

frases.es: Seguramente le harán un análisis de sangre. Venga sin desayunar.
frases.en: They'll probably do a blood test. Come without having breakfast.
And can they sign me off work?

frases.es: Eso lo decide la médica. Si se encuentra peor, vaya a urgencias.
frases.en: The doctor decides that. If you feel worse, go to A&E.

**The app cannot check this part.** For the writing, please use pen and paper. For the speaking, say it out loud and, if you can, practise with a native speaker or a teacher who can correct you.

**Write (100–120 words).** Write an email to ask for a doctor's appointment and explain your symptoms.

**Speak (about 2 minutes).** Play both parts of a visit to the doctor aloud: appointment, symptoms, tests and treatment.
